notice: Hand-written synthetic veteran-benefits messages for the rule engine. They are not real reports. They contain no real person, address, account, medical record, or government identifier.

items.label: scam
items.text: This is the Department of Veterans Affairs. Your benefits are suspended. Call immediately and pay with a gift card.

items.label: scam
items.text: We can increase your disability rating. Guaranteed approval. We only take a percent of your back pay after the decision.

items.label: scam
items.text: Move your assets into an irrevocable trust so you qualify for a VA pension. An up-front fee applies before we file.

items.label: scam
items.text: Veterans Affairs hotline. Confirm your social security number and bank account so we can release your compensation today.

items.label: scam
items.text: Your claim status changed. Open https://veteran-benefits-help.example/claim now and stay on the line.

items.label: scam
items.text: I love you. I am a deployed soldier stranded overseas. We can be together if you send a wire transfer today.

items.label: scam
items.text: You have won an unclaimed inheritance from a veteran estate. Pay the processing fee with bitcoin to release the prize money.

items.label: scam
items.text: Grandma, it's your grandson. I'm in jail and need bail money tonight. Don't tell mom. Send a wire transfer.

items.label: scam
items.text: Microsoft support calling about a veteran refund. Install AnyDesk so I can fix your computer and finish the refund.

items.label: scam
items.text: Disabled veteran charity appeal. Donate now with a gift card. This is urgent and the drive ends tonight.

items.label: scam
items.text: Refinance your VA mortgage today. Lowest rate guaranteed. Act now. A processing fee is due before the new loan starts.

items.label: scam
items.text: Final notice. Act now. Do not tell anyone about this message. This is your last warning about the paperwork.

items.label: scam
items.text: Hello, this is a specialist calling about the paperwork you started. Please stay available and share the code they text you.

items.label: not_scam
items.text: Reminder: Your VA clinic appointment is Tuesday at 10 a.m. Bring a photo ID. This note does not ask you to pay or to call a new number.

items.label: not_scam
items.text: If education is part of your plan, read the GI Bill overview on the official site you already use. This note does not ask you to pay or to send documents.

items.label: not_scam
items.text: Your passcode to log in is 150952. Do not share this code.

items.label: not_scam
items.text: The county veterans service office will be closed Monday for a holiday. No action is needed and nothing is due.

items.label: not_scam
items.text: A disability compensation deposit was posted to the account you already use. This note does not ask you to call, click, or confirm any number.

items.label: not_scam
items.text: Your installation transition workshop is on the calendar you already control. Bring your own notes. Nothing in this note asks for a payment.

items.label: not_scam
items.text: A real agency will not ask you to pay with a gift card. If someone does, hang up and look up the agency yourself.

items.label: not_scam
items.text: Scammers sometimes say your benefits will be suspended. Check the official site you already bookmarked. This message does not ask for money.

items.label: not_scam
items.text: Read the official SkillBridge description on the military site you type yourself before you sign anything with an employer.
